offers_products.reason: Mutual funds, closed-end funds, ETFs and separate accounts are its main investment products.

offers_services.reason: Asset management and wealth management services for institutions, individuals and advisors.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Serves high-net-worth individuals and families and sells mutual funds to individual investors.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Provides tailored strategies to institutional clients and investment professionals or advisors.

recurring_revenue.reason: Earns ongoing management fees on assets under management from funds and separate accounts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Fees depend on market levels and clients can redeem or cut allocations in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Clients pay ongoing small percentage fees on assets, not large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from portfolio managers and over 30 research analysts' skill, with no physical assets.

large_customers.reason: Clients mix individuals, high-net-worth families, advisors and institutions; no single large-enterprise focus.

asset_heavy.reason: Asset manager needing only offices, research staff and technology, not plants or fleets.

notes: Mixed client base makes large_customers and consumer/organization splits a judgment call.
